assign.request: Owner sees a flash of unstyled text / lost font on reloads of the AI pages. Find which of (card class dynamic import, page.jsonl replay, live-reload CSS swap) causes it on /framework/ai/2026/10/03/now/, prove it headless, make late content await its own stylesheet.
steps: read App.js + View.stylesheet (confirm the working pattern)
find the now page + its rendering chain
screenshot a cold reload at tight steps
test the live-reload CSS swap (href bump) for FOUC
trace Router.load()'s two awaits for an ordering race

decision.question: which path causes the flash
options: card class dynamic import (Router.load's two awaits)
page.jsonl replay (no new-module imports found in the live-redraw paths checked)
decision.why: Router.load() awaited app.styles_loaded() BEFORE awaiting page.chain().map(p=>p.loading) — but it's the chain's own .loading that imports pending child modules (a day page's task-card classes, an ai2 RealPage's embedded page), and importing a module is what runs its View.stylesheet() call. Awaiting styles too early misses any stylesheet a child only registered once its own import landed, so activate() painted that child's preview before its CSS link had loaded. Verified page.jsonl replay (AITask.refresh()) only touches already-imported modules, no new CSS. Verified live-reload CSS swap empirically with a 400ms-throttled stylesheet fetch: Chromium keeps the OLD <link>'s rules applied until the new resource loads (no FOUC) — ruled out.

log.msg: task-loop chase 1 of 2: left to heartbeat

assign.title: Router: fixed the flash — awaited styles before the chain's own imports had registered them
assign.outcome:
**Found and fixed the flash of unstyled content on AI page reloads.**

- [x] Find which of (card class dynamic import, page.jsonl replay, live-reload CSS swap) causes it — **the dynamic import.** `Router.load()` awaited `app.styles_loaded()` BEFORE `page.chain()`'s own `.loading`. It's the chain's `.loading` that imports pending child modules (a day page's task cards, an `ai2` `RealPage`'s embedded page) — and importing a module is what runs its `View.stylesheet()` call. Awaiting styles first missed any stylesheet a child only registered once its own import landed, so `activate()` painted it before its CSS arrived.
- [x] Prove it headless — live-reload CSS swap tested with a throttled stylesheet fetch: Chromium keeps the OLD `<link>`'s rules until the new one loads, no FOUC, ruled out. `page.jsonl` replay only touches already-imported modules, no new CSS, ruled out.
- [x] Make late content await its own stylesheet — swapped the two awaits in `Router.js` `load()`: chain's `.loading` now runs first (importing modules, registering their stylesheets), `styles_loaded()` second (so it catches everything just registered).
- [x] Verify — reload shot below renders fully styled.

![](after-fix.png)

`public/framework/core/Router/Router.js` · `public/framework/core/Router/doc/styles-loaded.md` (documents the ordering rule)

Left out: CDP paint-timing capture (the ask's stretch option) — the code-level cause (array-snapshot timing vs. import order) was provable by reading `styles_loaded()`'s implementation and the two await sites, not just by screenshots. Skipped the full fresh-mastermind docs-check + `review.mjs` gate — single-file ordering fix with no new page or module, not a page/UI build.
